_comment: Machine-readable lineage for the warehouse. The lineage-aware prompt arm receives a rendered form of this so it can reason about where a DP-layer metric movement actually originates (which upstream table/transform to drill into). The naive arm receives only the dp.* views; the schema-aware arm receives xform.* + dp.* but NOT this lineage graph.

grain_notes.raw.ecom_sales: monthly snapshot; product id is PARTNER id (CHEWY_PRODUCT_PART_NUMBER), not manufacturer sku
grain_notes.raw.retail_sales: monthly POS; product id is manufacturer vendor_part_no (= sku_id)
grain_notes.raw.vetclinic_sales: TRANSACTIONAL invoice-line grain (day-level, many lines per product/region/month)
grain_notes.raw.ecom_fillrate: monthly fill-rate/inventory snapshot; ecom partner only
grain_notes.raw.returns: multi-channel; product_ref is partner id for ecom, sku_id otherwise

stage.ecom_sales.transform: rename_to_common_vocab; product_key stays PARTNER id (mapping deferred)

stage.vetclinic_sales.transform: AGGREGATE invoice lines -> monthly grain; volume-weighted price

xform.fct_sales.transform: ecom mapped to sku via crosswalk (INNER JOIN); retail/vet already sku; UNION ALL; SUM to sku x month x region x channel
xform.fct_sales.lineage_risk: ecom rows whose partner_pid is absent from master_crosswalk are DROPPED here (inner join). They exist in raw/stage but vanish at transform.

xform.fct_returns.transform: ecom returns mapped via crosswalk; others already sku; SUM to sku x month x region x channel

xform.fct_inventory_fillrate.transform: mapped via crosswalk; AVG fill_rate, SUM on_hand/forecast

dp.sales_by_species_channel_month.transform: SUM units/revenue by species x channel x month

dp.otc_rx_performance.transform: SUM by species x modality x region x quarter; blended_price = revenue/units (LOSSY: hides per-sku price moves)

dp.net_sales_by_species_channel_quarter.transform: gross minus returns -> net; COLLAPSES gross-vs-net split needed to see a returns spike

dp.region_performance.transform: SUM by species x region x quarter

drill_hints._comment: Generic diagnostic drill paths a lineage-aware analyst would know. These are NOT cause-specific answers; they are reusable navigation knowledge that the lineage-aware arm is given and the naive arm is not.
apparent_drop_in_dp_metric: split revenue into price x volume at xform.fct_sales (a price move hides in DP blended_price)
break down by sku at xform.dim_product (a single discontinued/added sku hides in family/species rollups)
break down by channel and region at xform.fct_sales (channel- or region-specific losses average out at species level)
join xform.fct_returns to separate gross vs net (a returns spike leaves gross flat but net down)
join xform.fct_inventory_fillrate (a supply/stockout gap suppresses units even when demand/forecast is intact)
RECONCILE stage vs xform row totals (if transform < stage for a scope, suspect a crosswalk/mapping gap dropping rows)
compare year-over-year for the same month (a recurring seasonal dip is NOT a root-cause event)
